hero.h1: Bathroom Remodeling in Chicago, On Time and Done Right
hero.subheadline: Jesus and the Jota team remodel bathrooms and kitchens and take care of the long list around them: framing, plumbing, cabinets, floors, paint and trim.

image.alt: Bathroom with dark marble-look wall panels, a black-framed glass shower door and a lighted mirror: bathroom remodeling in Chicago by Jota Handyman Remodeling

intro.h2: One team for the bathroom and everything around it
paragraphs: Jota Handyman Remodeling LLC handles bathroom remodeling in Chicago, and customers often hire us for more than one thing. In a single basement project, Jesus framed the bathroom, hung a new door, installed the half bath vanity and plumbing, built a waterproofed shower niche, fixed squeaky floors and painted the walls, ceiling and trim.

We are a newer company, and we earn trust the way one early customer described: professional work, great results and a commitment to finishing on time. Another homeowner had garage painting, outside painting, cabinets and new outdoor lights done in one day. Both jobs show how one crew can work through a whole list.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom updates, from large marble-look wall panels, black-framed glass shower doors and lighted mirrors to new vanities, plumbing and hardware. We take care of every part of the room, so it is finished and ready to use, not half done.

image.alt: Black half bath vanity with a white top, chrome faucet and towel ring on a fresh grey wall

items.name: Basement bathrooms and shower niches
items.blurb: Turning unfinished basement space into a bathroom means framing, plumbing and waterproofing done in the right order. We frame the room, install the vanity and plumbing and build waterproofed niches with glass mosaic tile for the shower.

image.alt: Recessed shower niche lined with green glass mosaic tile in a white marble-look tile wall

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens on our profile include black shaker-style cabinets with brass pulls, white counters and wood-look floors. One recent project started as a full demolition and ended with new kitchen cabinets and lighting, laminate flooring, new doors and a custom TV wall with a fireplace.

image.alt: Kitchen with black cabinets, brass pulls, white countertops, a stainless gas range and wood-look floor

items.name: Garage and laundry cabinets
items.blurb: Extra storage in the garage or laundry room makes a big difference. We install garage cabinets and laundry cabinets and can paint the garage at the same visit, protecting the floor while we work. One customer had both done by our team.

image.alt: Freshly painted garage with wall storage and the floor covered in protective paper

items.name: Painting and trim, inside and out
items.blurb: Walls, ceilings, trim, garages and exteriors. Customers have hired us to paint inside and outside the house and to do the exterior trim. We protect floors and surfaces with paper and tape before the first coat goes on.

image.alt: Two-story house with brick and siding, a front porch and a landscaped walkway

items.name: Repairs and carpentry
items.blurb: New doors and frames, squeaky floors, bathroom hardware, built-in shelving and new outdoor lights. The small jobs that pile up are easier to fix in one visit with a team that can handle all of them.

image.alt: New white six-panel interior door with a silver lever handle

items.title: On time, as promised
items.text: Customers mention our commitment to finish the job in time, and one said we came on time and finished the whole job in a day. Meeting deadlines matters to us.

items.title: Many trades, one crew
items.text: Framing, plumbing, tile, carpentry, floors and paint. One basement customer had seven different tasks done by the same team, so there was no juggling of contractors.

items.title: Details you will not see, done right
items.text: A shower niche has to be waterproofed before the tile goes on. We build those hidden layers carefully, because they are what keeps water where it belongs.

items.title: Reviews answered personally
items.text: We have a 5.0 rating from 41 Google reviews and reply to our customers ourselves. One customer started out skeptical because we were new and ended up highly recommending us.

about.h2: About Jesus and Jota Handyman Remodeling
about.text: Jota Handyman Remodeling LLC is a remodeling and repair company in Chicago. Customers know us through Jesus, who leads the work alongside his team. On our Facebook page we put it simply: we transform your spaces, improve your homes and make your ideas a reality. We are a young company and have built our reputation one job at a time, from a full basement bathroom to a garage that was painted and fitted with cabinets in a single day. That work has earned a 5.0 rating from 41 reviews on Google. You can call us or message us on WhatsApp.
about.owner_role: Leads the work with his team, named in Google reviews (exact title not published)

image.alt: Living room wall with built-in white shelves around a TV and a linear electric fireplace

steps.title: Call or WhatsApp
steps.text: Reach us at (312) 586-6495 by phone or WhatsApp, or email us. Send a few photos and a short list of what you want done.

steps.title: Visit and plan
steps.text: We look at the space, go through your list with you and agree on what will be done and when it will be finished.

steps.title: Protect and prepare
steps.text: We cover floors and surfaces before we start, as you can see in our garage photos, so the rest of your home stays clean.

steps.title: Do the work
steps.text: Our team completes each item on the list, from framing and plumbing to tile, cabinets, paint and trim, working to the agreed deadline.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: We walk through the finished work with you and go over the list together, so you can point out anything you want us to look at.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling and repairs in Chicago
service_area.text: Jota Handyman Remodeling LLC is based in Chicago and comes to you; our Google profile lists no street address to visit. We work on bathrooms, basements, kitchens, garages and exteriors. If you are not sure whether we cover your neighborhood or suburb, call or WhatsApp (312) 586-6495 with your address and a short description of the job, and we will let you know.

items.q: Can you do several jobs in one visit?
items.a: Yes, that is how most of our customers use us. One basement project included framing, a new door, a half bath vanity and plumbing, a waterproofed shower niche, floor squeaks, paint and hardware. Another customer had painting, cabinets and outdoor lights done in one day.

items.q: Do you remodel kitchens as well as bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Bathrooms are our main category on Google, and we also remodel kitchens. One recent project went from full demolition to new kitchen cabinets and lighting, laminate flooring, new doors and a custom TV wall. Send us photos of your kitchen and tell us what you want to change.

Call or WhatsApp (312) 586-6495, or email jotahandymanservices@gmail.com. Photos of the space and a short list of what you need help us understand the job faster. Our Google profile lists us as open 24 hours Monday to Saturday and 7 AM to 10 PM on Sunday.

Finishing on time is something customers mention in their reviews, and meeting our clients' deadlines is important to us. We agree on the timeline before we start and plan the work around it. One customer had a full list of garage and exterior work done in one day.

items.q: You are a new company. Why should I trust you?
items.a: One customer wrote that they were skeptical at first for exactly that reason, then were happily surprised by our professionalism and the great work. We now have 41 Google reviews averaging 5.0, and you can read every one of them, with our replies, on our Google profile.

final_cta.text: Call or WhatsApp Jota Handyman Remodeling and tell us what needs doing.
